title: FNaF Music Disk Mod
description: Adds Five Nights at Freddy's music discs to Minecraft!
body:
# FNaF Music Disk Mod

Bring the music of the FNaF community into Minecraft!

This mod adds music discs featuring **Five Nights at Freddy's fan songs**. Collect them, play them in jukeboxes, and enjoy some of the most popular tracks from the FNaF fandom while exploring your world.

## Features

* Adds music discs with FNaF fan songs.
* Listen to your favorite tracks using a jukebox.
* A growing collection of songs from different FNaF artists.
* Easy to use and fits naturally into vanilla Minecraft.

Whether you're building a pizzeria, exploring caves, or relaxing at your base, these music discs let you enjoy FNaF fan music without leaving the game.

## Planned Features

* More FNaF fan songs in future updates.
* Music from newer FNaF games and fan projects.
* Additional ways to obtain the music discs.
* More customization and improvements.

## Suggestions

Have a favorite FNaF fan song that isn't included yet? Let me know in the comments! I'm always looking for suggestions to expand the collection.
